dedupe_keys.name: mapy potrzeb zdrowotnych poland health needs maps with demographic epidemiological service staff and equipment data and forecasts by voivodeship editions 2022 2026 and 2027 2031

description: The health needs maps are the Polish Ministry of Health's planning analyses of health care needs for each voivodeship and for the country, now published on an open analysis platform run by the ministry's Department of Analyses and Strategy. The page read on 2026-09-28 explains that the maps combine demographic and epidemiological data with data on the health services delivered and on the use of staff and medical equipment, and use them to forecast future needs for health services by region. Since 2019 the updates appear only on the digital platform, not as long documents, and the page links the editions for 2022 to 2026 and 2027 to 2031 as well as earlier editions. Coverage is Poland, by voivodeship and nationally. Access is free; the footer reserves all rights and no licence was read, and the platform's tables and export options were not opened. Caveats: forecasts rest on the ministry's assumptions, and indicators may change between editions. It supports health service capacity studies, such as comparing forecast hospital demand with current beds and equipment in each region. Related records: the NFZ health service statistics and the register of health care providers.
